@everyone 


Diving into the Heart of the Cornucopias Gaming Ecosystem and Economy!
,
Economy in and of itself is a complex and difficult thing to manage in a game world, especially in an MMO. When you involve a blockchain asset like a fungible token, in our case $COPI, the ecosystem becomes even more complex to plan and manage. That said, our entire team is very excited to be releasing the long awaited information about our token ecosystem and core utilities of $COPI. We have invested significant thought and effort into developing a system from scratch, spearheaded by experts in tokenomics and data analysis. But game economy is equally important, which is why we have recently brought in a game economist to create a balanced gameplay experience with realistic progression and the joy of achievement. 

As mentioned before, this economy will not be perfect at the start, but is designed with the flexibility to make changes and improvements. There will be obstacles to overcome, but the takeaway here is that we have designed something with strong foundational principles crafted by intelligent minds with strong backgrounds in their expertise. 

Please visit our updated wiki page (see link below) for a breakdown of the ecosystem and token utility. 

It should be noted that this announcement addresses only the first half of the entire economy. The details of the in-game economy are still in heavy planning and will be released at a later date. It should also be noted that as our game grows and is put through its phases of testing, parts of the ecosystem and economy are subject to change if we see ways to make improvements.
